description: The EU Reference Scenario 2020 is one of the European Commission key projection tools for energy, transport and climate action. It sets out the long-term economic, energy, climate and transport outlook for the EU and its Member States under the policy framework in place in 2020, and it is the baseline from which the policy scenarios and variants behind the July 2021 European Green Deal package were built. National experts from all EU countries contributed through a consultation process, and stakeholders contributed on technology assumptions. The Commission page offers the report and Excel workbooks available for free download: main results on energy, transport and greenhouse gas emissions, results for non-CO2 emissions, for land use and forestry and for air pollution, and technology assumptions for energy and for transport. Coverage is the EU and its Member States. Caveats: the page carries a disclaimer that the Commission does not guarantee the accuracy of data developed by external contractors, it reflects policies as of 2020, and no licence is named on the page. Simulation uses are baseline demand, generation mix and technology cost assumptions for long-term capacity planning and scenario comparison across energy carriers. Related records: data-entsos-tyndp-scenarios gives the grid planning scenarios.
